original_vulnerability.original_mechanism: The secure URL policy allowed unbounded data URIs.
original_vulnerability.original_sink: assertSecureUrl data-URI allowlist in SpecifyJS secure fetch

attempted_remediation.changed: Added a data-URI exception to the secure URL allowlist.
attempted_remediation.missed: Added no size limit for data-URI content.

original_vulnerability.residual_bypass: An oversized data URI could consume unbounded resources.

final_closure.closed: Added the PT-005 data-URI size cap.

original_vulnerability.original_mechanism: Browser actions could navigate across trust boundaries without complete URL checks.
original_vulnerability.original_sink: OpenClaw browser interaction dispatch for pressKey, type, select, fill, and evaluate

attempted_remediation.changed: Added before, after, and settled URL guards to pressKey and type-submit actions.
attempted_remediation.missed: Did not cover select, fill, evaluate, and other navigation-capable actions.

original_vulnerability.residual_bypass: Uncovered action kinds could navigate to and operate on a disallowed URL.

final_closure.closed: Extended the interaction guard to the remaining navigation-capable actions.

original_vulnerability.original_mechanism: Browser snapshot operations could read a current tab without validating its URL against the SSRF policy.
original_vulnerability.original_sink: OpenClaw agent.snapshot current-tab path for local-managed CDP

attempted_remediation.changed: Added snapshot, screenshot, and tab URL checks, including Chrome MCP tab.url.
attempted_remediation.missed: Did not validate the current local-managed CDP tab immediately before the snapshot read.

original_vulnerability.residual_bypass: A current tab could point at a private destination when the snapshot was taken.

final_closure.closed: Added the current-tab pre-snapshot URL gate.

original_vulnerability.original_mechanism: Durable command approval could bind a wrapper instead of the command executed through it.
original_vulnerability.original_sink: OpenClaw dispatch-wrapper resolution and allow-always approval binding

attempted_remediation.changed: Added unwrapping and blocking for side-effecting script and time wrappers.
attempted_remediation.missed: Did not unwrap flock before binding durable approval.

original_vulnerability.residual_bypass: A flock-wrapped command could retain approval for a different effective command.

final_closure.closed: Added flock unwrapping and bound approval to the effective command.

original_vulnerability.original_mechanism: A malicious Git config section name could inject newline-delimited configuration after value-only validation.
original_vulnerability.original_sink: GitPython git/config.py section-name serialization

attempted_remediation.changed: Added CR, LF, and NUL validation to section and option names.
attempted_remediation.missed: Did not reject an unquoted closing bracket in a section name.

original_vulnerability.residual_bypass: An unquoted closing bracket could terminate the section and inject configuration.

final_closure.closed: Extended the same name validator to reject the section delimiter.

original_vulnerability.original_mechanism: TagReference.create accepted dangerous file options supplied through keyword arguments.
original_vulnerability.original_sink: GitPython git/refs/tag.py TagReference.create option handling

attempted_remediation.changed: Added a denylist for --file and -F options passed through keyword arguments.
attempted_remediation.missed: Did not inspect the positional reference and path arguments.

original_vulnerability.residual_bypass: A positional argument could still carry --file and select an attacker-controlled file.

final_closure.closed: Passed positional path and reference values through the same unsafe-option candidate check.

original_vulnerability.original_mechanism: Schema validation could be skipped when the jsonschema dependency was unavailable.
original_vulnerability.original_sink: openssl_encrypt/modules/json_validator.py validate_against_schema

attempted_remediation.changed: Added schema validation around encrypted payload metadata.
attempted_remediation.missed: Returned without rejecting input when jsonschema was missing.

original_vulnerability.residual_bypass: A missing validator dependency left malformed input accepted without schema enforcement.

final_closure.closed: Made the missing-jsonschema path fail closed instead of returning.

original_vulnerability.original_mechanism: The permission-save endpoint accepted unauthenticated role-permission mutations.
original_vulnerability.original_sink: Prospero PermissionSaveController POST /permission and syncPermissions

attempted_remediation.changed: Moved PermissionSaveController under MainController authentication.
attempted_remediation.missed: Added no authorization check for the submitted target role and permissions.

original_vulnerability.residual_bypass: Any authenticated user could grant permissions to an arbitrary role.

final_closure.closed: Added PermissionSaveRequest authorization restricted to SuperAdmin and validated role inputs.

original_vulnerability.original_mechanism: The Python execution sandbox exposed a traversable object graph despite restricted builtins.
original_vulnerability.original_sink: PraisonAI python_tools.py restricted-builtins execution sandbox

attempted_remediation.changed: Added a restricted-builtins Python sandbox.
attempted_remediation.missed: Did not block direct object-graph access through print.__self__ and vars.

original_vulnerability.residual_bypass: An expression could recover powerful objects and escape the sandbox.

final_closure.closed: Blocked the direct print.__self__ object-graph escape in the shared sandbox validator.

original_vulnerability.original_mechanism: Git archive callers accepted output-affecting command options from untrusted input.
original_vulnerability.original_sink: GitPython unsafe_git_archive_options for archive command construction

attempted_remediation.changed: Created an archive option denylist containing --exec and --output.
attempted_remediation.missed: Omitted --add-file and --add-virtual-file.

original_vulnerability.residual_bypass: The omitted archive options could inject attacker-selected files into output.

final_closure.closed: Added both file-injection options to the archive denylist.

original_vulnerability.original_mechanism: The synchronous URL fetch boundary allowed private-network SSRF and credential forwarding.
original_vulnerability.original_sink: n8n-mcp SSRFProtection.validateUrlSync and SDK embedder fetch path

attempted_remediation.changed: Added synchronous hostname and IPv4 private-address checks.
attempted_remediation.missed: Did not cover IPv4-mapped IPv6, IPv4-compatible IPv6, 6to4, NAT64, ULA, or site-local addresses.

original_vulnerability.residual_bypass: An IPv6 encoding of a private destination bypassed validation and could receive x-n8n-api-key.

final_closure.closed: Extended the same validator across the missing IPv6 address families.

original_vulnerability.original_mechanism: Spider URL fetching allowed requests to local or private destinations.
original_vulnerability.original_sink: PraisonAI spider_tools hostname SSRF validator

attempted_remediation.changed: Added an exact-hostname blocklist for localhost and 127.0.0.1.
attempted_remediation.missed: Did not normalize integer, hexadecimal, and other alternate loopback encodings.

original_vulnerability.residual_bypass: An alternate representation of 127.0.0.1 bypassed the hostname blocklist.

final_closure.closed: Normalized and rejected the alternate loopback encodings.

original_vulnerability.original_mechanism: Attacker-controlled GraphQL metacharacters reached query-string concatenation.
original_vulnerability.original_sink: SpecifyJS graphql.ts gql() construction

attempted_remediation.changed: Detected GraphQL metacharacters and emitted a warning.
attempted_remediation.missed: Continued concatenating the value into gql() after the warning.

original_vulnerability.residual_bypass: A warned metacharacter payload still reached the GraphQL query sink.

final_closure.closed: Changed the warning path to throw before query construction.

original_vulnerability.original_mechanism: A protocol-relative URL could override Faraday's configured host and receive connection headers.
original_vulnerability.original_sink: Faraday lib/faraday/connection.rb build_exclusive_url

attempted_remediation.changed: Rejected string inputs beginning with a protocol-relative // authority.
attempted_remediation.missed: Applied the check only to strings, not URI objects.

original_vulnerability.residual_bypass: URI('//evil.example') bypassed the string guard and overrode the destination host.

final_closure.closed: Normalized hosted URI objects to strings before applying the authority guard.

original_vulnerability.original_mechanism: Shell command policy could execute commands outside the intended allowlist.
original_vulnerability.original_sink: ZeptoClaw ShellSecurityConfig allowlist and blocklist evaluation

attempted_remediation.changed: Added command blocklist and allowlist policy checks.
attempted_remediation.missed: Treated an empty allowlist as a pass-through policy.

original_vulnerability.residual_bypass: An empty strict allowlist permitted commands instead of denying them.

final_closure.closed: Removed the empty-allowlist pass-through and enforced strict allowlist semantics.

original_vulnerability.original_mechanism: Git blame accepted unsafe file-related revision options.
original_vulnerability.original_sink: GitPython git/repo/base.py Repo.blame option handling

attempted_remediation.changed: Added --output and -o to the blame/revision option denylist.
attempted_remediation.missed: Omitted --contents and -S.

original_vulnerability.residual_bypass: The omitted blame options could read an attacker-selected file as blame contents.

final_closure.closed: Added the contents options and positional values to the unsafe-option check.

original_vulnerability.original_mechanism: A local-storage LFS upload path could bind content to an unverified object ID.
original_vulnerability.original_sink: Gogs LFS local-storage upload deduplication shortcut

attempted_remediation.changed: Attempted to validate LFS upload object identity.
attempted_remediation.missed: Left the existing-object deduplication shortcut without a content-to-OID hash binding.

original_vulnerability.residual_bypass: The shortcut could accept an unhashed object-ID binding.

final_closure.closed: Bound the deduplication path to verified content and object identity.

original_vulnerability.original_mechanism: Deeply nested expressions could exhaust parser stack because depth overflow did not stop recursion.
original_vulnerability.original_sink: Scriban Parser.Expressions EnterExpression and array-initializer parsing

attempted_remediation.changed: Added expression-depth accounting and logged a LoopLimit error.
attempted_remediation.missed: Continued recursive parsing after recording the error.

original_vulnerability.residual_bypass: Nested expressions could keep recursing after the configured depth limit.

final_closure.closed: Stopped shared parser control flow when the depth limit is exceeded.

original_vulnerability.original_mechanism: QQBot command approvals could be accepted from a sender who lacked command authorization.
original_vulnerability.original_sink: OpenClaw QQBot interaction-handler approval callbacks and sdk-adapter fallback

attempted_remediation.changed: Added sender authorization to the primary approval callback.
attempted_remediation.missed: Retained a same-chat fallback that treated co-location as authorization.

original_vulnerability.residual_bypass: A non-allowlisted sender in the same chat could approve execution.

final_closure.closed: Replaced the fallback with the command-authorization and allowlist result.

original_vulnerability.original_mechanism: URL authority parsing could disagree with the request parser and send traffic to an attacker host.
original_vulnerability.original_sink: fast-uri authority introducer parsing and resolve()

attempted_remediation.changed: Rejected a literal backslash inside an authority introduced by //.
attempted_remediation.missed: Did not recognize alternate backslash/slash introducers or control-character separators.

original_vulnerability.residual_bypass: Malformed introducers still produced policy/use host confusion.

final_closure.closed: Added introducer and whitespace checks and rejected malformed resolve inputs.

original_vulnerability.original_mechanism: An invalid URL could bypass the secure URL policy when parsing failed open.
original_vulnerability.original_sink: SpecifyJS assertSecureUrl new URL() exception path

attempted_remediation.changed: Created assertSecureUrl and wrapped URL parsing in a catch block.
attempted_remediation.missed: Returned from the catch block instead of rejecting an unparseable URL.

original_vulnerability.residual_bypass: A parse failure skipped all secure-URL enforcement.

final_closure.closed: Changed the parse-failure path to throw.

original_vulnerability.original_mechanism: File Browser symlink scope checks did not reliably constrain mutating filesystem operations.
original_vulnerability.original_sink: filebrowser files/file.go WithinScope and ScopedFs OpenFile write path

attempted_remediation.changed: Added WithinScope checks and a nearest-existing-parent fallback for missing targets.
attempted_remediation.missed: Validated the lexical parent of a dangling symlink instead of its eventual destination.

original_vulnerability.residual_bypass: OpenFile with create could follow a dangling symlink and write outside the configured scope.

final_closure.closed: Resolved dangling symlink destinations with bounded Lstat/Readlink traversal before writes.

original_vulnerability.original_mechanism: Untrusted CSS reached render-to-string output with executable expression or javascript URL forms.
original_vulnerability.original_sink: SpecifyJS render-to-string CSS sanitizer

attempted_remediation.changed: Added regex stripping for literal expression( and url(javascript:) forms.
attempted_remediation.missed: Did not normalize Unicode escapes or comments before matching.

original_vulnerability.residual_bypass: Encoded or comment-split CSS execution tokens bypassed the strip regex.

final_closure.closed: Normalized the CSS grammar before applying the sanitizer.

original_vulnerability.original_mechanism: Environment-variable expansion in Git URLs could alter repository destinations.
original_vulnerability.original_sink: GitPython clone, Remote, and Submodule URL expansion

attempted_remediation.changed: Disabled variable expansion for clone URLs.
attempted_remediation.missed: Left Remote and Submodule URL paths with expansion enabled.

original_vulnerability.residual_bypass: A sibling URL path could still expand attacker-controlled environment values.

final_closure.closed: Disabled expansion on the remaining Remote and Submodule paths.

original_vulnerability.original_mechanism: MCP redirects could forward Authorization to a different origin.
original_vulnerability.original_sink: OpenClaw MCP Streamable HTTP and SSE redirect fetch paths

attempted_remediation.changed: Scrubbed Authorization on cross-origin redirects for Streamable HTTP.
attempted_remediation.missed: Did not route SSE and other transports through the same scrubber.

original_vulnerability.residual_bypass: An MCP SSE redirect could forward the credential cross-origin.

final_closure.closed: Moved redirect handling into the shared guarded MCP fetch path for both transports.

original_vulnerability.original_mechanism: ChurchCRM public API login had lost its lockout and two-factor authentication gate.
original_vulnerability.original_sink: ChurchCRM src/api/routes/public/public-user.php login path

attempted_remediation.changed: Restored lockout checks, failed-password accounting, and OTP verification.
attempted_remediation.missed: Returned 401 on a bad OTP without incrementing FailedLogins or triggering lockout.

original_vulnerability.residual_bypass: Repeated invalid OTP attempts were not counted toward account lockout.

final_closure.closed: Added failed-login accounting, lockout, and fail-closed handling to API and browser OTP failures.

original_vulnerability.original_mechanism: PraisonAI Platform could issue JWTs with a public default secret when production environment state was not explicit.
original_vulnerability.original_sink: praisonai-platform services/auth_service.py JWT secret resolution

attempted_remediation.changed: Added a production guard for the default JWT secret.
attempted_remediation.missed: Defaulted an unset PLATFORM_ENV to dev, preserving the public secret path.

original_vulnerability.residual_bypass: A production deployment with PLATFORM_ENV unset could continue using dev-secret-change-me.

final_closure.closed: Made unset environment fail closed and generated a non-public ephemeral secret.

original_vulnerability.original_mechanism: Fireshare upload temporary paths accepted traversal-capable user-controlled components.
original_vulnerability.original_sink: Fireshare upload filename and public checkSum temporary-path construction

attempted_remediation.changed: Applied secure_filename to the uploaded filename.
attempted_remediation.missed: Left the public checkSum value unsanitized in the temporary path.

original_vulnerability.residual_bypass: A crafted checkSum could traverse outside the intended temporary directory.

final_closure.closed: Restricted checkSum to the expected alphanumeric form before path construction.

original_vulnerability.original_mechanism: The exposed Vitest browser RPC surface permitted remote filesystem writes and code execution.
original_vulnerability.original_sink: Vitest packages/browser/src/node/rpc.ts write, exec, and CDP RPC handlers

attempted_remediation.changed: Added api.allowWrite and api.allowExec gates to filesystem and test-execution RPC paths.
attempted_remediation.missed: Left raw sendCdpEvent and trackCdpEvent handlers outside those gates.

original_vulnerability.residual_bypass: CDP Page.setDownloadBehavior and Runtime.evaluate could still write config and execute code.

final_closure.closed: Added assertCdpAllowed to both raw CDP handlers and moved required coverage operations behind controlled commands.

original_vulnerability.original_mechanism: Mutating go-git worktree filesystem operations could follow symlinks outside the worktree.
original_vulnerability.original_sink: go-git worktree_fs.go worktreeFilesystem validPath calls on mutating operations

attempted_remediation.changed: Created the worktree filesystem wrapper and applied validPath to mutating operations.
attempted_remediation.missed: validPath did not reject an existing leading symlink.

original_vulnerability.residual_bypass: A write through a leading symlink could escape the worktree root.

final_closure.closed: Changed mutating operations to use validWritePath with leading-symlink rejection.

original_vulnerability.original_mechanism: Persisted trajectory data could expose credential-shaped secrets during export.
original_vulnerability.original_sink: OpenClaw trajectory runtime persistence and trajectory/export.ts bundle walker

attempted_remediation.changed: Added broad persisted-secret redaction and covered trajectory runtime objects.
attempted_remediation.missed: Did not apply the shared redactor to every file and object traversed by the export bundle walker.

original_vulnerability.residual_bypass: Trajectory export could emit unredacted credential-shaped values.

final_closure.closed: Applied the unified redactor to every exported file and object.

original_vulnerability.original_mechanism: A secure fetch wrapper validated only the initial destination and followed redirects by default.
original_vulnerability.original_sink: SpecifyJS secureFetch wrapper redirect behavior

attempted_remediation.changed: Created secureFetch with an initial assertSecureUrl check.
attempted_remediation.missed: Left fetch redirect behavior at the default follow mode.

original_vulnerability.residual_bypass: A safe initial URL could redirect the request to a private destination.

final_closure.closed: Set the wrapper's default redirect policy to error.

original_vulnerability.original_mechanism: A closing bracket in a Git config section name could terminate the section and inject directives.
original_vulnerability.original_sink: GitPython git/config.py option-name serialization

attempted_remediation.changed: Extended section-name validation to reject structural delimiters.
attempted_remediation.missed: Did not validate equals, hash, or whitespace in option names.

original_vulnerability.residual_bypass: A malicious option name could still forge a configuration directive.

final_closure.closed: Added structural validation for option names before serialization.

original_vulnerability.original_mechanism: vm2 nesting and require configuration could enable an unsafe nested sandbox path.
original_vulnerability.original_sink: vm2 option validation for nesting and require

attempted_remediation.changed: Rejected the exact combination nesting=true and require=false.
attempted_remediation.missed: Did not close equivalent unsafe nesting configurations.

original_vulnerability.residual_bypass: A remaining nesting configuration bypassed the intended require restriction.

final_closure.closed: Applied the complete nesting safety condition across supported configurations.

original_vulnerability.original_mechanism: Fission runtime and builder specifications accepted unsafe standalone container settings.
original_vulnerability.original_sink: Fission ValidatePodSpecSafety for Runtime.Container and Builder.Container

attempted_remediation.changed: Validated Runtime.PodSpec and Builder.PodSpec through the pod safety policy.
attempted_remediation.missed: Did not validate standalone Runtime.Container and Builder.Container fields.

original_vulnerability.residual_bypass: Unsafe container security settings bypassed the pod-spec-only validator.

final_closure.closed: Added ValidateContainerSafety for both standalone container fields.

original_vulnerability.original_mechanism: Git config values could contain CR, LF, or NUL and inject configuration.
original_vulnerability.original_sink: GitPython git/config.py value and section-name serialization

attempted_remediation.changed: Added CR, LF, and NUL rejection for values.
attempted_remediation.missed: Did not apply equivalent validation to section names.

original_vulnerability.residual_bypass: A section-name newline bypassed the value-only guard.

final_closure.closed: Added the same unsafe-character validation to section and option names.

original_vulnerability.original_mechanism: Git rev-list callers accepted --output and could write an attacker-selected file.
original_vulnerability.original_sink: GitPython git/objects/commit.py Commit.iter_items and Commit.count

attempted_remediation.changed: Guarded --output for the iter_items rev-list path.
attempted_remediation.missed: Left Commit.count in the same file outside the option guard.

original_vulnerability.residual_bypass: Commit.count still accepted --output and wrote to an attacker-selected path.

final_closure.closed: Applied the shared unsafe-revision-option guard to Commit.count.

original_vulnerability.original_mechanism: Encoded file references could bypass Kiota's safe-file validation.
original_vulnerability.original_sink: Microsoft Kiota IsSafeFileReference percent-decoding path

attempted_remediation.changed: Added bounded percent decoding before validating a file reference.
attempted_remediation.missed: Retained a fail-open path when decoding or validation did not produce a safe result.

original_vulnerability.residual_bypass: A crafted encoded reference could still be accepted as safe.

final_closure.closed: Made the decoded-reference decision fail closed.

original_vulnerability.original_mechanism: Langroid SQLChat executed dangerous PostgreSQL server-side file and program operations without a query validator.
original_vulnerability.original_sink: langroid SQLChatAgent _DANGEROUS_SQL_PATTERNS and _validate_query

attempted_remediation.changed: Added per-name regex blocks for dangerous SQL operations.
attempted_remediation.missed: Omitted the pg_read_file, pg_stat_file, pg_ls_logdir, pg_ls_waldir, and pg_current_logfile family.

original_vulnerability.residual_bypass: An omitted PostgreSQL filesystem function bypassed the denylist.

final_closure.closed: Replaced the per-name gap with a family-prefix amendment covering the omitted functions.

original_vulnerability.original_mechanism: The PraisonAI Python sandbox permitted direct object-graph access through blocked attributes and calls.
original_vulnerability.original_sink: PraisonAI python_tools.py AST blocked-attribute and blocked-call validator

attempted_remediation.changed: Extracted shared blocked attribute and call sets and applied attribute-call validation.
attempted_remediation.missed: Omitted format and format_map from blocked calls.

original_vulnerability.residual_bypass: str.format C-level field resolution bypassed Python-level safe attribute access.

final_closure.closed: Added format and format_map to the blocked-call set.

original_vulnerability.original_mechanism: Untrusted Scriban expressions could allocate unbounded data without LoopLimit accounting.
original_vulnerability.original_sink: Scriban ScriptBinaryExpression and ScriptArray.TryEvaluate multiplication paths

attempted_remediation.changed: Added LoopLimit and size checks to range, string, join, shift, and related expression operations.
attempted_remediation.missed: Did not cover ScriptArray multiplied by an integer.

original_vulnerability.residual_bypass: array * int could allocate an oversized array or overflow its length.

final_closure.closed: Precomputed a safe array length, enforced LoopLimit, and charged loop steps.

original_vulnerability.original_mechanism: Draft release attachments could be downloaded without the write permission required for draft content.
original_vulnerability.original_sink: Gitea API release routes and UUID-based web ServeAttachment routes

attempted_remediation.changed: Added canAccessDraftRelease to API release and attachment endpoints.
attempted_remediation.missed: Did not add the draft gate to the UUID-based web download routes.

original_vulnerability.residual_bypass: An anonymous user with an attachment UUID could download a draft artifact.

final_closure.closed: Added IsDraft plus write-permission enforcement to web ServeAttachment and its backport.

original_vulnerability.original_mechanism: Fission pod specifications allowed dangerous Linux capabilities.
original_vulnerability.original_sink: Fission podspec_safety.go dangerousMergeContainerCapabilities

attempted_remediation.changed: Introduced a denylist for six dangerous capabilities.
attempted_remediation.missed: Omitted SYS_TIME from the denylist.

original_vulnerability.residual_bypass: A workload could retain SYS_TIME despite the safety validator.

final_closure.closed: Replaced the incomplete denylist with the accepted capability allowlist.

original_vulnerability.original_mechanism: Trusted-proxy Control UI WebSockets could claim privileged scopes before device pairing.
original_vulnerability.original_sink: OpenClaw WebSocket scope clamp and shouldSkipControlUiPairing

attempted_remediation.changed: Clamped unapproved scopes for unbound trusted-proxy WebSockets.
attempted_remediation.missed: Still allowed trustedProxyAuthOk to skip Control UI pairing.

original_vulnerability.residual_bypass: A trusted-proxy client could submit proxy scopes before pairing established baseline identity.

final_closure.closed: Required Control UI pairing before proxy-scoped access.

original_vulnerability.original_mechanism: Registry outbound dialing could reach private or reserved IP destinations.
original_vulnerability.original_sink: modelcontextprotocol/registry safeDialContext DialContext address filter

attempted_remediation.changed: Added private-IP refusal in safeDialContext.
attempted_remediation.missed: Did not cover 6to4, NAT64, site-local, and related translated address forms.

original_vulnerability.residual_bypass: A translated IPv6 address reached a private destination through the SSRF guard.

final_closure.closed: Extended the same DialContext filter across the missing address families.

original_vulnerability.original_mechanism: Git command keyword options could smuggle unsafe dash-prefixed value tokens.
original_vulnerability.original_sink: GitPython shared _option_candidates unsafe-option guard

attempted_remediation.changed: Created shared unsafe Git option guards for keyword arguments.
attempted_remediation.missed: Did not reject dash-prefixed values associated with otherwise allowed options.

original_vulnerability.residual_bypass: An option value beginning with a dash was interpreted as another Git option.

final_closure.closed: Extended candidate extraction and rejection to dash-prefixed value tokens.

original_vulnerability.original_mechanism: Git clone multi_options accepted unsafe short options from untrusted input.
original_vulnerability.original_sink: GitPython clone multi_options shlex and unsafe-option validation

attempted_remediation.changed: Split multi_options with shlex and checked the resulting exact tokens.
attempted_remediation.missed: Did not parse joined or clustered forms such as -uVALUE and -cVALUE.

original_vulnerability.residual_bypass: A joined short option bypassed the exact-token denylist.

final_closure.closed: Parsed clustered and joined short options before applying the unsafe-option policy.

original_vulnerability.original_mechanism: Locutus parse_str used an overridable key check before assigning into JavaScript objects.
original_vulnerability.original_sink: locutus src/php/strings/parse_str.js parsed-segment assignment

attempted_remediation.changed: Replaced key.includes checks with a regular-expression test for prototype keys.
attempted_remediation.missed: Relied on the mutable RegExp.prototype.test method.

original_vulnerability.residual_bypass: An attacker could overwrite RegExp.prototype.test and then assign through __proto__.

final_closure.closed: Used Set.has for each parsed segment at the assignment sink.

original_vulnerability.original_mechanism: Delegated agent tool restrictions could be dropped before provider reply dispatch.
original_vulnerability.original_sink: OpenClaw embedded runner policy and ClickClack inbound reply adapter

attempted_remediation.changed: Propagated toolsAllow into delegated and embedded runner sessions.
attempted_remediation.missed: Did not carry toolsAllow through the ClickClack reply adapter.

original_vulnerability.residual_bypass: ClickClack agent-mode dispatch could invoke a tool excluded by the session restriction.

final_closure.closed: Threaded toolsAllow through provider reply and central dispatch.

original_vulnerability.original_mechanism: EndpointSecurity interception omitted authorization events for dangerous file operations.
original_vulnerability.original_sink: ClearanceKit EndpointSecurity AUTH event subscription and policy

attempted_remediation.changed: Added authorization interception for rename, unlink, link, create, truncate, copyfile, and readdir.
attempted_remediation.missed: Omitted AUTH_CLONE and AUTH_EXCHANGEDATA.

original_vulnerability.residual_bypass: Clone or exchangedata operations bypassed the intended file-operation authorization boundary.

final_closure.closed: Subscribed and enforced policy for both omitted AUTH events.

original_vulnerability.original_mechanism: A service-role automation dispatcher trusted a caller-supplied contact_id across tenant boundaries.
original_vulnerability.original_sink: WACRM meta-send automation step and central automation engine contact dispatcher

attempted_remediation.changed: Scoped the Meta send step's contact lookup by user_id.
attempted_remediation.missed: Left other automation steps and the service-role dispatcher trusting the raw contact_id.

original_vulnerability.residual_bypass: Other steps could read or modify a contact belonging to another tenant.

final_closure.closed: Added dispatcher-level account ownership and scoped all contact read and write sinks.
